description: Parse a Cookie request header's name=value pairs and compute each cookie's serialized byte size and the total header size, flagging any cookie over RFC 6265's 4096-byte per-cookie guarantee and the total against a configurable budget (4096 bytes by default).

budgetBytes.description: Total byte budget to check against; defaults to 4096

cookieHeader.description: The Cookie header value to parse, e.g. "session=abc123; theme=dark"

name: calculate_cookie_size_budget
